title: 30-second duel: which one is better for you?
lead: Tap how much each thing matters to you. We weigh how each model ranks among all models in our catalogue on those specifications and tell you which one fits you.
tie: A draw: both suit you about equally — pick by price or design.
wins: Ahead on {n} of the {m} things you care about.
basis: Score = the share of catalogue models each one beats on these specifications, weighted by your answers. Price, design and reviews are not included.
none: Choose at least one thing that matters to you.
